reviewed_version: arXiv:2312.02849v4, submitted29May2025, PDF title date10June2025,49pages; journal-final equivalence not assumed
paper_title: Algorithms for Mean-Field Variational Inference Via Polyhedral Optimization in the Wasserstein Space
summary: Four Major issues: APGD domain theorem, higher-order monotonicity constraints, Gaussian-tail leverage constant, and metric factor in mixture flows. Five separately calibrated Minor corrections. No author code executed or journal-version equivalence asserted.

problems.title: APGD queries outside the domain covered by its hypotheses
problems.location: Theorem4.2 and Algorithm1 pp.9–10; application Theorem5.12 p.19
problems.check: rho=N(0,1),T=x+1,Q=2,K=[1,2],F(mu)=g(E_mu X), g=x^2+4x with +48(1-x)^3 below1 and +6(x-2)^3 above2. g is C2; on K m=1,M=4. Starting2 with beta1/3 yields 1,2,1,2; t2 gap7 exceeds bound2. Gaussian KL example alpha1,T=x,Q1,lambda0=.1 gives eta1=(-31+21sqrt2)/110<0 and Hessian>2, so cone smoothness does not cover it.
problems.result: Abstract theorem false as stated; its MFVI application needs an extrapolation-domain argument.
problems.counterevidence: No failure of KL APGD itself established; only actual violation of available smoothness-domain bound.
problems.correction: Cover all extrapolation points by valid convexity/smoothness assumptions, or analyze a feasible-query accelerated method; merely projecting momentum does not establish the claimed rate.

problems.title: The higher-order coefficient constraints do not ensure monotonicity
problems.check: d=1,alpha=delta=1,two cells[-1,0],[0,1],negative quadratic coefficient1 on first and positive1 on second,all others0. Total constraint0 and cubic cap satisfied, but T=x-psi_quad+(x+1)+psi_quad+(x) has T'(0)=-1. Scaling coefficientsalpha*delta extends example to every small delta.
problems.result: Claim that every feasible map is strongly monotone is false; transport-geometry and algorithm extension unsupported for this K.
problems.counterevidence: Does not refute existence of specially constructed accurate approximants, which can satisfy stronger constraints.
problems.correction: Impose nonnegative derivative at every knot via every prefix sum of signed quadratic coefficients; retain cubic cap. Piecewise linear derivative then nonnegative before alpha and cubic terms.

problems.title: Uniform Gaussian-tail leverage bound drops cell probability
problems.check: Centered last ramp s with p=P(Z>=R-delta) has s(R)>=1-p, Qjj<=p, so leverage(R)>=(1-p)^2/p and Xi/J^2>=(1-p)^2/(pJ^3). With epsilon=exp(-R^2/4),delta~sqrt(epsilon/R),J~2R^(3/2)exp(R^2/8), Mills bound makes ratio grow exp(R^2/8)/R^(7/2).
problems.result: Xi<=CJ^2 is false uniformly in Gaussian truncation regime; discarded interval mass in p47 proof is essential.
problems.counterevidence: Upsilon bound uses conditional variance and is not contradicted. Theorem5.17 conditional on actual Xi remains; no lower bound on actual SGD complexity proved.
problems.correction: Retain tail dependence or supply a sharper weighted stochastic variance analysis/different dictionary; rederive the advertised corollary.

problems.title: Mixture gradient-flow coefficient velocities omit the inverse Gram matrix
problems.location: Theorems7.1/7.2 pp.26–27 versus AppendixE Eq30 p.49
problems.check: For rho=pi=N(0,1),T=2x,Q=4,alpha1,lambda1, derivativeKL=16/3; printed lambda velocity=-16/3, Q-metric gradient velocity=-4/3.
problems.result: Displayed ODEs are not gradient flows for the stated Q+I metric when Q!=I.
problems.counterevidence: AppendixEq30 contains correct inverse; main finite-dimensional SPGD uses inverse. No mixture convergence rate claimed.
problems.correction: Apply Q inverse to full coefficient gradient in both theorems and particle formulas; treat boundary normal cone separately if needed.

problems.title: Strong convexity does not ensure attainment on every geodesically convex set
problems.check: C={N(a,1):a>0},pi=N(0,1);KL=a^2/2 has infimum0 but no minimizer.
problems.result: Unrestricted existence statement false; uniqueness conditional on attainment is valid.
problems.correction: State at-most-one minimizer and prove attainment under appropriate separate assumptions for each application.

problems.title: SPGD proof implicitly sets constrained optimum gradient to zero
problems.check: f=.5x^2+x,K=[0,1],Q=m=M=1,x*=0 gives grad1, contradicting gradient-norm bound by distance0. Comparing projection against fixed point x*=Proj(x*-h gradf*) instead yields recurrence coefficient1-2mh+(M^2+c1)h^2 and noise c0h^2.
problems.result: Displayed proof inequality false, but conditional claimed rate repairable with same order and step caps.
problems.correction: Use projection fixed point and unbiased noise; step caps h<=m/(2M^2),m/(2c1) give coefficient<=1-mh. Handle c0=0 separately.

problems.title: Gaussian KL formula has wrong target log-determinant sign
problems.check: A=Sigma=2 yields printed KL=-log2 although identical distributions have0.
problems.counterevidence: Target-dependent constant does not change optimal diagonal covariance formula.

problems.title: Logistic data-generation Bernoulli parameter is invalid
problems.check: exp(theta^T X)>1 for positive dot product; probability must be sigmoid. Static BayesianUtils and notebook use sigmoid.
problems.result: Printed reproduction recipe invalid; paper/snapshot also differ in normalization and translation step.
problems.counterevidence: No claim that published data used invalid probabilities; historical code uses valid sigmoid.
problems.correction: Correct sigmoid and specify actual normalization, step size and experiment snapshot.

problems.title: Pinned alpha-sweep notebook passes one constant alpha
problems.check: Loop variablealpha ranges alpha_opt,alpha_opt/10,alpha_opt/50 but every SPGD call firstargumentalpha_opt; AST static verification.
problems.result: This snapshot does not implement the advertised alpha sweep.
problems.counterevidence: No evidence that published figure was generated by this exact historical snapshot; no author code run.
problems.correction: Pass loop variable alpha and identify actual figure-generating version before asserting reproduction.
